name: thinking-skills
description: A domain-neutral thinking skills framework with intent routing, method bases, article visual production, and specialized thinking modes.

interface.shortDescription: Domain-neutral intent routing and thinking modes
interface.longDescription: Use Thinking Skills to route user requests into domain-specific thinking modes for content creation, approval-gated article visual production, technical deep dives, learning support, emotional support, conversation self-review, and future life decision, creative, and business workflows.
defaultPrompt: I have an idea and want to think it through.
Help me decide what thinking mode this request needs.
Plan and integrate visuals for this final Markdown article.
I want to write something, analyze something technical, learn a concept, sort out an emotional issue, or self-review this conversation.
